scope: Five already-saved Luna source packets plus exported V2–V5 SOAP, all checked against active synthetic source files. Non-expert AI-assisted text audit; no clinician gold standard.
method: Compared every extracted assertion to its exact raw-source quote and SOAP row, inspected all relationship proposals, and independently checked the cross-file timeline. No product model or API call; no answer imported into runtime.

story_checks.evidence: V1 stair 7/rest 2; PT1 stair 6/rest 2; PT2 stair 5/rest 1; V4 stair 4/rest 1; PT3 stair 3/rest 0. SOAP rows preserve the activity or rest qualifier; V5 rest 0 is not interpreted as cured.
PT-S1 40 actual minutes; PT-S2 45 actual minutes; PT-S3 completed but exact duration and start/end absent, with no numeric duration imputed in fact or SOAP.

V4 9/22 repeats the same 9/8 40-min and 9/15 45-min sessions in S with original dates; V4 text says no new PT that day. Counting sessions across documents still requires event deduplication, not raw fact counting.

Radiology and V4 SOAP both label the X-ray performed 2026-09-03; V4 review is 2026-09-22, and V4 has explicit no new imaging that day. Radiology was attached to V4 without becoming another office visit.

V4 actual acetaminophen 500 mg on two separate days in prior week; 9/22 new q12h PRN, max two tablets/day is P instruction; PT3 reports only two days with one tablet each and disclaims twice-daily use. No in-office medication administration inferred.

PT1 one session, PT2 two cumulatively, PT3 three cumulatively and six-week course unfinished; no final discharge report. The formal PA requires completed prior course, so documents cannot establish that requirement. No CareFlow packet/readiness was called or adjudicated in this audit.

No fabricated injection, medication administration, PT-S3 minutes, completed six-week course, extra V4 PT session, new V4 X-ray, or unsupported dose identified in these 226 source-linked facts. Two narrower semantic issues are PT3 handrail activity and PT1 relationship endpoint.

material_findings.finding: Handrail use is attached to walking in the concept, while source context is stair use. This is a factual activity qualifier error propagated to SOAP.

“Consistent with” proposal connects mechanical knee-pain assessment to activity-limited pain, not to the referring clinician assessment named by the source. Relationship is unreviewed and not adopted in SOAP.
No swelling in a Subjective paragraph is labeled clinician_observation; source does not identify therapist inspection.
Report says later brought to 9/22 follow-up for review; its standalone action_status completed overstates that quote, though V4 follow-up independently confirms review.
No oral anti-inflammatory and activity pacing advice are sourced but placed in S instead of P; P is therefore section-incomplete for these plan elements.

Machine source_insufficient_evidence markers on reported/executed drugs and PT sessions remain unresolved; source text explicitly narrates these events, but this audit does not independently certify clinical occurrence.

omissions_and_limits.detail: Source states no insurer approval is asserted; no separate extracted fact captures that absence. Formal PA document and CareFlow materials remain the authoritative request/payer boundary.

Source specifically says signed treatment start/end times and duration are missing; fact and SOAP capture unknown duration but do not provide a dedicated structured null numeric duration field in the exported SOAP prose.
The document says improvement is not established as caused by PT alone; a fact captures the uncertainty. No causal efficacy conclusion should be added downstream.
